Day One: Arrive in Tokyo  
Thee shall check in at a traditional inn  
Thou shalt visit the Meiji Shrine  
Thou shalt walk through Yoyogi Park  
Thou shalt dine on sushi at Tsukiji Outer Market  

Day Two: Explore Eastern Tokyo  
Thee shall ascend Tokyo Skytree  
Thou shalt gaze upon the city from its observation deck  
Thou shalt wander Asakusa and see Senso-ji Temple  
Thou shalt try ningyo-yaki sweets  
Thou shalt cruise the Sumida River at sunset
